verdict.rationale: Kushki's own docs include a section titled "Webhooks para tarjeta presente" (webhooks for card-present payments), which shows first-party outbound event callbacks exist, at least for in-person card payments. The evidence is only a section heading, with no detail on how to register endpoints, which event types exist, payload format, signature verification, or retries, and no sign of webhook coverage for online, recurring, or refund events. Missing for 10: webhook registration/subscription docs, event catalog across payment products, payload and signature verification details, retry/delivery guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
